title: Live Interactive Sessions
description: Real-time classroom sessions where teachers and students interact through polls, Q&A, and feedback

teacher.overview: Sessions are live interactive classes where you engage students with polls, Q&A, and real-time feedback. Each session is conducted within a room.

start: Open the room where you want to conduct session
Session goes live - students can now join
Session code is generated for students to join
Begin your class and use interactive features
manage: See real-time count of joined students
Create and launch polls during session
Answer student questions from Q&A panel
Broadcast important messages to all students
end: Click 'End Session' button when class is over
Session data is saved to room history

tips: Start session 5 minutes before class for students to join
Use polls every 10-15 minutes to maintain engagement
Check Q&A panel regularly for student questions
End session properly to save all data
Review session analytics after class to improve teaching
canDo: Start unlimited sessions in your rooms
See all joined students in real-time
Create polls, Q&A, and gather feedback during session
View detailed session analytics after session ends
cannotDo: Run multiple sessions simultaneously in the same room
Edit session data after it ends
Restart a session after ending it
Force students to stay in session
bestPractices: Share session code before class starts
Keep sessions under 90 minutes for best engagement
Use mix of polls, Q&A, and discussions
Monitor student count to ensure everyone joined
Always end session properly to save data

student.overview: Sessions are live classes where you participate in polls, ask questions, and give feedback. Join using the session code from your teacher.

join: Go to 'Join Session' page (or click from room)
Click 'Join' - you're now in the live session
Participate in polls, Q&A, and feedback
participate: Answer polls when teacher launches them
leave: You can rejoin using same session code if session is still active
Your participation data is saved even if you leave early

tips: Join sessions on time to not miss important content
Keep internet connection stable throughout session
Participate actively in polls and Q&A
Ask questions when you don't understand
Provide honest feedback to help teacher improve
canDo: Participate in all polls and Q&A
View your response history after session
Access session recordings if teacher shares them
cannotDo: See other students' poll answers in real-time
Join sessions from rooms you haven't joined

commonIssues.solution: Verify code with teacher, check for extra spaces, ensure session is still active
Rejoin using same session code, check internet connection, refresh page
Refresh page, ensure you're in correct session, check if teacher launched the feature
Rejoin immediately using same session code if still active
